business_problem: ELPEDISON needed to bring customer and enterprise data together across siloed operational systems so it could improve service, strengthen governance and compliance, and create a trustworthy foundation for analytics and future AI use cases.
solution_summary: ELPEDISON selected a data integration and governance stack built on IBM Cloud Pak for Data and IBM Knowledge Catalog, delivered as a SaaS offering by Performance Technologies and containerized on Red Hat OpenShift on IBM Cloud. The program was not only about consolidating data but about turning 30,000 database tables across 45 operational systems into a governed enterprise resource. Performance Technologies and IBM embedded an energy-and-utilities-oriented catalog, aligned ELPEDISON's business terminology to the platform and created central catalogs, dictionaries and governance workflows for lineage, quality, validation, remediation and traceability. That layer gives business and compliance teams a 360-degree view of customer and enterprise data while also supporting GDPR, the EU Data Act and the EU AI Act. The architecture combines cloud-native integration, cataloging and policy control in one platform instead of leaving sensitive data spread across opaque silos.
products_used: Red Hat OpenShift on IBM Cloud

solution_components.name: IBM Cloud Pak for Data
solution_components.role: Provides the cloud-native data integration and governance platform at the center of ELPEDISON's enterprise data framework.

solution_components.name: IBM Knowledge Catalog
solution_components.role: Maintains data catalogs, dictionaries and governance metadata used to classify and trace enterprise data.

solution_components.name: Red Hat OpenShift on IBM Cloud
solution_components.role: Hosts the containerized SaaS implementation managed by Performance Technologies.

data_flow: Data from 45 operational systems is cataloged and governed through Cloud Pak for Data and Knowledge Catalog, where metadata, lineage, quality and ownership controls are applied before business units and compliance teams use the resulting 360-degree view for analytics, service and policy enforcement.
business_outcome: ELPEDISON improved customer-data visibility, sped issue resolution, strengthened compliance oversight and created an AI-ready enterprise data framework that can support more accurate services and recommendations.
